mapper.select: select * from facilityReservation where rsv_status is not null

SELECT t.round, t.time, CASE WHEN fr.time1 = t.time OR fr.time2 = t.time OR fr.time3 = t.time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status_no, t.facility_no FROM timeTable t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT facility_no, rsv_date, time1, time2, time3 FROM facilityReservation WHERE rsv_date = #{rsv_date} AND facility_no = #{facility_no} ) fr ON t.facility_no = fr.facility_no AND (fr.time1 = t.time OR fr.time2 = t.time OR fr.time3 = t.time) WHERE t.facility_no = #{facility_no};
select facility_name from facility where facility_no=#{facility_no}
select mem_no,mem_name, mem_phone from member where mem_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') AND mem_delete is null
